_NOTE: Field names and value domains VERIFIED on 2026-10-28 by reading all 353 records of the live GDI-Saarland layer Schutzgebiete_INS:Wasserschutzgebiet. The layer publishes NO status, restriction-category or extraction-rate attribute (stored as UNKNOWN/NULL). VERORDNUNG is the date of the legal ordinance, not a data-update date, so updated_field is null. LAND holds SL (350 rows) and RLP (3 rows), so state_code is taken from it.

value_maps._comment: Exact-match lookup after whitespace/case normalisation. NO substring or regex inference. SCHUTZZONE takes exactly the values B, I, II, III in the live data. 'B' (1 record, WSG Bietzener Wiesen) is a separate zone defined by that ordinance ('Schutzzone B', permit-required activities) - seen in search-result excerpts of the ordinance text, NOT yet read in full: confirm against the ordinance (record URL attribute). Any other value becomes UNKNOWN + ZONE_UNMAPPED.
